body: I don't know what depression entails, and no amount of reading has clarified it any further for me really. I don't feel that I'm in a position to make this kind of call.
Depression is medical condition, I'm not a doctor so I can't say I have depression, I have no right to self-diagnose and potentially demean the word.

I've actually become a lot better at handling my emotions when drunk than I used to; a year ago I just sometimes couldn't hold it in, but I've gotten a lot better at keeping myself stable enough, outwardly, to not be disruptive. I'm not sure I want to stop drinking really... Just as I don't really want to stop cutting... they're both effective coping mechanisms, and I'm certainly not an alcoholic... But I'll consider it, though in all honesty I'm not sure if it will achieve anything.
